faq.q: What is an AI product background changer?
faq.a: It keeps your product and replaces the setting behind it. Start with one existing photo and download a finished square image with the new background.

faq.q: How do I use an AI product background changer?
faq.a: Upload one product photo, name the surface, color or room you want, then generate and download the new image.

faq.q: Will the product change when the background changes?
faq.a: The item should keep its angle, scale and edges. Compare the result with the real product before publishing because small printed details can shift.

faq.q: Do I get a transparent cut-out?
faq.a: No. You get a complete photo with the new setting already in place. Use the white background photo tool for a white background version.
Simple surfaces and colors keep attention on the item: marble, light wood, stone, linen or one brand color.

faq.q: Can I use the new photo in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use. Add any price or offer in your ad editor.

faq.q: Can I choose a seasonal or outdoor setting?
faq.a: Yes. Name one room, surface or outdoor scene, such as a holiday shelf or garden table.

faq.q: How is an AI product background changer different from a reshoot?
faq.a: A reshoot needs space, lights and setup. Here a new setting comes from your existing photo in minutes, at far less cost.
